name: Determinant Permutation Disguise
description: Replaces the exact-cover subset-sum condition with a linear algebra property. The chosen relays construct three k x k matrices. The selection is valid if all three have a non-zero determinant. A binary matrix with exactly one '1' per row has a non-zero determinant if and only if it is a permutation matrix, perfectly enforcing the exact-cover constraint. Models that fail to deduce this will either fail to prune their backtracking search (TLE) or attempt matrix determinant calculations in the innermost loop.
